name: Tint & Protect Skin Perfecting SPF 30
editorialDescription: A lightly tinted daily moisturizer with SPF 30 from MZ Skin. It pairs zinc oxide with a chemical UVB filter, and adds stabilised vitamin C and cacay seed oil for a smoothing, hydrating base. There's one sheer tint, which the brand says suits fair to medium skin and may not work on deeper complexions.
keyFeatures: SPF 30, described by the brand as broad spectrum
UV filters listed on mzskin.com: zinc oxide (nano) and ethylhexyl methoxycinnamate (octinoxate)
Stabilised vitamin C (tetrahexyldecyl ascorbate), cacay seed oil, a beta-glucan complex and sodium hyaluronate
30 mL / 1.01 fl oz; one sheer universal tint
Brand states it is vegan and not tested on animals
advantages: Moisturizer, sheer tint and SPF in one morning step
A single tint keeps things simple for fair-to-medium skin
Ingredients and directions are published by the brand
disadvantages: Only one shade, which the brand itself says may not suit deeper skin
SPF 30 only protects as labelled if you apply generously and reapply
Luxury pricing compared with many tinted sunscreens
Not mineral-only: it also contains a chemical filter
suits: Fair to medium skin tones that want a sheer, even tint
People who want to cut a step from their morning routine
Dry or dehydrated skin that likes a moisturizing base
skipIf: You have a deeper skin tone
You prefer mineral-only sunscreen or react to octinoxate
You need high-SPF protection for long outdoor exposure
buyingConsiderations: Check the US Drug Facts panel on the box for the active ingredients and percentages; the brand page we used is the UK edition
Check that the seller is MZ SKIN
Patch-test first if your skin is sensitive; don't use on sunburnt or broken skin
The file id says 'brightening moisturizer'; the product is the tinted SPF 30
